info.title: Conversation details
info.immutableStrong: Messages can be neither edited nor deleted.
info.immutableText: This guarantees their value as evidence, for you and for the other participants.
info.timestamp: Every message is timestamped when it's sent. The “Read” label shows that a recipient has opened the conversation.
info.vault: Nothing is added to your Vault without your consent: use “Save to the Vault” on an attachment, or turn on automatic filing in the Vault settings.
info.tone: The AI Coach tone check suggests a rewording before sending. Each checked message uses AI credits (like a situation analysis). It never blocks your message, even without credits.
info.count: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} · to add to your file
info.archiveHint: Archiving tucks the conversation away for you only. Nothing is deleted.
